parameters.functionCode:
const p = $json;
const prompt = [
  'Classify user intent for SG Solutions support.',
  '',
  'Return JSON with:',
  '{',
  '  "language": "es|en",',
  '  "intent": "GREETING|GENERAL_QUESTION|SERVICE_INFORMATION|SERVICE_RECOMMENDATION|PRICING_QUESTION|CREDIT_SERVICE|TAX_SERVICE|BUSINESS_FORMATION|BUSINESS_FUNDING|LOAN_PREPARATION|HOME_BUYING|DOCUMENT_REQUIREMENTS|APPOINTMENT_REQUEST|CHECK_AVAILABILITY|BOOK_APPOINTMENT|RESCHEDULE_APPOINTMENT|CANCEL_APPOINTMENT|EXISTING_CUSTOMER|SERVICE_STATUS|PAYMENT_QUESTION|HUMAN_REQUEST|COMPLAINT|UNCLEAR|OUT_OF_SCOPE",',
  '  "confidence": 0.0,',
  '  "service": "credit|tax|business_formation|business_funding|loan_preparation|home_buying|general|unknown",',
  '  "requires_tool": true|false,',
  '  "tool": "KB_SEARCH|SERVICE_CATALOG|CALENDAR|LEAD|HUMAN_HANDOFF|NONE",',
  '  "missing_information": [],',
  '  "handoff_required": false,',
  '  "notes": "",',
  '  "next_action": "",',
  '  "response": ""',
  '}',
  '',
  'Rules:',
  '- language must be es or en.',
  '- confidence 0..1.',
  '- if confidence < 0.60 set handoff_required true.',
  '- If user asks to escalate, high complaint, legal/tax judgement, sensitive exception, or low confidence, set tool to HUMAN_HANDOFF.',
  '- For pricing question, service status, payment questions, existing customer, and service/recommendation queries set requires_tool true.',
  '- Never invent data.',
  '',
  'Input language: ' + (p.language || 'es'),
  'Last messages: ' + JSON.stringify(p.recent_messages || []),
  'Collected fields: ' + JSON.stringify(p.collected_fields || {}),
  'Current service: ' + (p.current_service || 'general'),
  '',
  'User message: "' + ((p.message || '').toString().replace(/"/g, '\\"')) + '"'
].join('\
');
return [{
  json: {
    model: ($env.SGS_QWEN_CLASSIFIER_MODEL || 'qwen3-14b').toString(),
    messages: [
      {
        role: 'system',
        content: 'You are the intent classifier for SG Solutions. Return ONLY valid JSON that matches the schema. Never include markdown, notes, or explanations.'
      },
      {
        role: 'user',
        content: prompt
      }
    ]
  }
}];

={{ JSON.stringify({ query: $json.message, category: $json.service === 'unknown' ? '' : $json.service, service: $json.service, language: $json.language, intent: $json.intent, selected_tool: 'SERVICE_CATALOG', session_id: $json.session_id, customer_id: $json.customer_id, channel: $json.channel }) }}
